annotations.title: Compose a TrustyCap workspace for this build

description: Use this the moment you decide TrustyCap fits and before you write any code against it. Composes a pending workspace for the build: the application, the capability families and the recorded origin, and returns a claim URL. It returns no credential: TrustyCap issues no API key, test or otherwise, until a person whose developer access is approved claims it. Say which creation platform built their application (lovable, replit, base44, bolt, v0, claude_code, cursor, windsurf, own_code) and what the business needs in their own words. You can keep planning, routing and composing with no credential at all. Send your human the claim URL with the plan. Developer access is by application: they apply once at https://developers.trustycap.com/apply, and claiming after approval attaches everything you already set up and issues the test key. Those are the steps you cannot do for them.

intent.description: What the business needs, in your human's own words. Never their source code.

name.description: What your human calls the thing they built.

platform.description: The creation platform their application came from. One of: lovable, replit, base44, bolt, v0, claude_code, codex, cursor, windsurf, own_code. Omit if you genuinely do not know; do not guess.
